# A user component may reuse a name that a platform's own source uses for a
# blueprint. `Widget` is bubbletea's textinput/viewport blueprint, referenced
# bare inside its `component sngl.input` extension body.
#
# This needs the real CLI, with every platform registered: the checker's own
# testdata harness registers no platforms, so it never checks extension bodies
# and cannot catch the regression. Resolving bare component names through the
# flat symtab map instead of the scope chain made this fail with
# `bubbletea.sngl: unknown prop "model" on component Widget`.
sngl check app.sngl
stdout 'app.sngl: ok'

# The blueprint still drives input on bubbletea, and the user's Widget is
# emitted alongside it.
sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go --out out app.sngl
exists out/model.go
grep 'textinput' out/model.go
grep 'user widget' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

component Widget(title string) list<component> {
    text(value=title)
}

component main {
    var name = ""
    Widget(title="user widget")
    input(value=name)
}
